|-
|[[Matrix differential equation|Matrix]]
|1
|<math>\mathbf{\dot{x}}(t) = \mathbf{A}(t)\mathbf{x}(t)</math>
|

|[[Picard-Fuchs equation|Picard-Fuchs]]
|2
|<math>\frac{d^2y}{dj^2} + \frac{1}{j} \frac{dy}{dj} + 
\frac{31j -4}{144j^2(1-j)^2} y=0</math>
|[[Elliptic curves]]
|-
|[[Riemann's differential equation|Riemann]]
|2
|<math>\frac{d^2w}{dz^2} + \left[
\frac{1-\alpha-\alpha'}{z-a} +
\frac{1-\beta-\beta'}{z-b} +
\frac{1-\gamma-\gamma'}{z-c} \right] \frac{dw}{dz} </math>
::<math>+\left[
\frac{\alpha\alpha' (a-b)(a-c)} {z-a}
+\frac{\beta\beta' (b-c)(b-a)} {z-b}
+\frac{\gamma\gamma' (c-a)(c-b)} {z-c}
\right]
\frac{w}{(z-a)(z-b)(z-c)}=0</math>
|
|-
|[[Quantum harmonic oscillator]]
|2
|<math>-\frac{1}{2}\frac{d^2\psi}{dx^2} + \frac{1}{2} x^2 \psi = E\psi </math>
|[[Quantum mechanics]]
|-
|[[Sturm-Liouville theory|Sturm-Liouville]]
|2
|<math>\frac{d}{dx}\!\!\left[\,p(x)\frac{dy}{dx}\right] + q(x)y = -\lambda\, w(x)y, </math>
